title: Local constant finite-module model for bounded cohomology on a site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site with final object $X$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and let $B$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $K\in D(\mathcal C,\underline B)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and integers $a\leq b$ satisfy $H^q(K)=0$ for $q\notin[a,b]$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Suppose every $H^q(K)$ is locally isomorphic to the constant sheaf of a finitely generated $B$-module [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. There exists a covering $\{U_j\to X\}$ such that on each localized site $\mathcal C/U_j$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], $K|_{U_j}$ is isomorphic in the derived category to the termwise constant sheaf complex $\underline{M_j^\bullet}$, where $M_j^\bullet$ is a cochain complex of finitely generated $B$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and $M_j^q=0$ for $q\notin[a,b]$. The differentials of $\underline{M_j^\bullet}$ are induced by the $B$-linear differentials of $M_j^\bullet$. No existence of points of the site is assumed.
